step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents Zillow's speech analytics pipeline for phone conversation data. First, audio call recordings are stored in an ingestion S3 bucket, which triggers AWS Step Functions. Step Functions orchestrates the workflow by sending audio data to AWS Transcribe for speech-to-text conversion (with PII reduction). The transcript is then passed to Amazon Comprehend to analyze sentiment and extract NLP features. The enriched metadata and intermediate results are written into an S3 Data Lake bucket. Finally, the enriched speech analytics data is ingested into Elasticsearch (OpenSearch) for indexing and internal user search capability.
